requiredOutcomes: M23a-M23f: admission and tile-major storage, per-tile visit, O(1) liveness, 16e9 scan allowance, overlay/mesh/census acceptance tests, render.rs assertions and digest under CAP-R5-01 and CAP-R5-03, host fake-backend and desktop cases, native parity; gates 1-4 exit 0 with positive pass counts.
M16: docs and CLI help discoverability, measured budgets, progress table with every milestone accepted, three final gates exit 0.

nonGoals: Redoing accepted milestones M1 to M15, M17 to M20 and M22.
cad3d M21 and cad3d M18; edits of cad3d design or plan files; README.md edits.
Design sections 2.3 and 2.4; any nodetto-cloud, server, auth, secret or deployment code.

Edits of census.rs, lattice.rs, interference.rs, interval.rs, overlay.rs, prism.rs, scene.rs, tests/support/mod.rs, tests/interference.rs, apps/cli/native/src/engine_tests.rs, fixture files or the TypeScript capture core.
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths; progress goes to their own plan file. No git state changes, no stash, branches or worktrees; never push.
English only, no emojis, strict TypeScript; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and the plan's own CARGO_TARGET_DIR; format only owned files.
A needed production change outside a plan's writePaths stops that plan with a recorded scope amendment; plans never widen their own scope.
Existing tests and deadlines are never weakened except the pre-authorized changes named in the plans; timing tests up to three attempts, then alone, all logged.
Per-edit fresh reads and git hash-object before and after each owned file; drift is recorded, not overwritten.
